definition.en:
The record a team's runs scored (RS) and allowed (RA) "should" produce. The gap to the real record mostly comes from close games.
1. Expected win % = RS^1.83 ÷ (RS^1.83 + RA^1.83)
2. Multiply by games played and round
definition.zh-TW:
依球隊的得分（RS）和失分（RA）推算「應該」有的戰績。和實際戰績的落差，大多來自比分接近的比賽。
1. 預期勝率 = RS^1.83 ÷ (RS^1.83 + RA^1.83)
2. 乘以出賽場數，四捨五入
